newsitem.title: USA: MediaNews affiliate buys Lowell Sun - reports.
newsitem.headline: MediaNews affiliate buys Lowell Sun - reports.

text.p: Garden State Newspapers, a affiliate of MediaNews Group Inc, has reached an agreement to buy the family-owned Lowell Sun newspaper of Lowell, Mass., Boston newspapers reported Wednesday.

Media mogul William Dean Singleton, who controls MediaNews Group, told the Boston Herald that he did not expect any drastic change in staff levels at the Lowell Sun, which employs 200 full-time and 150 part-time workers.
The Sun has a daily circulation of 52,234 and a Sunday circulation of 55,804, making it the fifth largest paper in the MediaNews chain, the Boston Globe reported.
